learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to draw human figures in action and perfectly place them into beautiful backgrounds and everyday scenes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Drawing people can seem tricky, but it is all about proportion! By using simple shapes like ovals and rectangles to measure the head, torso, and legs, you can easily draw a realistic human body.

People are rarely completely still. Whether they are running for a bus or reading a book, capturing the bend of their knees and the tilt of their shoulders brings your drawings to life with exciting movement.

A character needs a world to live in! Using perspective helps you draw backgrounds like streets, parks, or rooms so that your drawn figures look like they are actually standing inside a real 3D space.

fun_activity.title: ✏️ The Secret Coffee Shop Artist
fun_activity.instructions: Sit quietly in a park or your living room. Do a quick 2-minute sketch of someone nearby who is doing a simple activity, like reading a newspaper or drinking tea, focusing only on their basic pose!

quick_recap: ⭐ Proportion is the key rule for drawing human bodies that look balanced and realistic.
⭐ Capturing simple body gestures and angles helps make your characters look energetic and alive.
⭐ Adding backgrounds and understanding perspective grounds your characters in a believable environment.
